units.source_text: 是晚匂亲王正在宫中，看来无法早退。

en.t: That evening, Prince Niou was at court and seemed unable to leave early.

units.source_text: 心中不胜焦灼，惟有独自悲叹。

en.t: His heart was unbearably restless, and he could only lament alone.

units.source_text: 明石皇后对他说道：“你至今还是个独身之人，而好色之名已经渐渐传播在世间，毕竟是很不好的事。

en.t: Empress Akashi said to him, "You are still unmarried, yet your reputation for amorousness is gradually spreading through the world, which is truly a very bad thing.

units.source_text: 无论何事，总不可随心所欲，任情而动。

en.t: In all matters, one must never simply follow one's desires and act on impulse.

units.source_text: 父皇也曾这样说你，替你担心呢。”

en.t: Your father the Emperor has said the same about you, and he worries for you."

units.source_text: 她埋怨他常居私邸。

en.t: She reproached him for spending so much time at his private residence.

units.source_text: 匂亲王听了这话，但觉痛苦之极，便走进自己的值宿室，且写一封信给宇治的女公子。

en.t: When Prince Niou heard this, he felt utterly miserable, went into his own night-duty room, and wrote a letter to the young lady at Uji.

units.source_text: 写毕之后，心中还是闷闷不乐。

en.t: After he finished writing, his heart was still gloomy and dejected.

units.source_text: 正在此时，薰中纳言走进来了。

en.t: Just then, Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, came in.

units.source_text: 此人与宇治有缘，他看见了异常高兴，对他说道：“怎么办呢？

en.t: Because this man had ties to Uji, Niou was extremely glad to see him and said, "What am I to do?

units.source_text: 天已经这样黑了，我心里真着急呢！”

en.t: It has already grown so dark, and I am truly anxious!"

units.source_text: 说罢连声叹气。

en.t: After saying this, he sighed again and again.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言想察探他对二女公子的态度如何，对他说道：“你好几天不进宫了，今晚不在宫中值宿，立刻告退，恐怕你母后更将怪怨你吧。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, wanted to sound out his feelings toward the second young lady, so he said, "You have not come to court for several days, and if you leave at once tonight without staying on duty in the palace, your mother will surely resent you even more.

units.source_text: 刚才我在侍女室中听见你母后责备你。

en.t: Just now, in the ladies' room, I heard your mother reproaching you.

units.source_text: 我偷偷地引导你到宇治去，恐怕也要受到严厉的叱责吧。

en.t: If I secretly guide you to Uji, I will probably receive a severe scolding too.

units.source_text: 吓得我脸色也发青了。”

en.t: I was so frightened that even my face turned pale."

units.source_text: 匂亲王答道：“母后以为我行为极坏，所以如此责备。

en.t: Prince Niou replied, "My mother thinks my conduct is terribly bad, and that is why she reproaches me like this.

units.source_text: 这多半是别人向她胡言乱语之故。

en.t: This is most likely because someone has been talking nonsense to her about me.

units.source_text: 我哪一件事情受到了世人的非难？

en.t: What single thing have I done that has drawn the world's criticism?

units.source_text: 总之，这高贵的身份，反而害得我不能自由。”

en.t: In the end, this noble rank of mine only keeps me from being free."

units.source_text: 他真心地讨厌自己是个皇子。

en.t: He sincerely hated the fact that he was an imperial prince.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言看他可怜，对他说道：“你反正总要受到某一方面的责备。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, felt sorry for him and said, "In any case, you are bound to be blamed from one side or another.

units.source_text: 你今晚的罪过，由我来代顶吧，我也不惜糟蹋自身了。

en.t: Let me take the blame for your offense tonight; I do not mind ruining myself for it.

units.source_text: ‘山城木幡里’，乘马去如何？

en.t: How about riding on horseback to 'Kohata Village in Yamashiro'?

units.source_text: 不过乘马更不容易避免外人注目。”

en.t: But if you ride a horse, it will be even harder to avoid other people's notice."

units.source_text: 此时日色沉沉欲暮，看看即将入夜。

en.t: By then the light was sinking toward dusk, and night was about to fall.

units.source_text: 匂亲王无可奈何，只得乘马出门。

en.t: Prince Niou had no choice but to mount a horse and set out.

units.source_text: 薰君对他说道：“我不奉陪，反而更好，可在这里代你值宿。”

en.t: Lord Kaoru said to him, "It would be better if I did not accompany you; I can stay here and take your place on night duty."

units.source_text: 他就留宿宫中。

en.t: So he stayed overnight in the palace.
